title: France: Pickleball in the French Alps
summary: Experience the perfect blend of sport and scenery in the French Alps. Enjoy daily pickleball sessions at PIKKEL near Chambéry, explore charming alpine towns, and relax in the spa town of Aix-les-Bains. This 10-day adventure offers a balance of activity, culture, and leisure in a stunning mountain setting.

pins.name: PIKKEL (Pickleball Club near Chambéry)
pins.address: Rue du Pré Pagnon, 73420 Drumettaz-Clarafond, France

sections.title: PICKLEBALL & THE FRENCH ALPS
sections.subtitle: Introduction
sections.html:
Active Alps Escape

Experience the perfect blend of sport and scenery in the French Alps. Enjoy daily pickleball sessions at PIKKEL near Chambéry, explore charming alpine towns, and relax in the spa town of Aix-les-Bains. This 10-day adventure offers a balance of activity, culture, and leisure in a stunning mountain setting.
